subject: baseline

judge_reason: Same defect: the new prefix test drops the empty-completion skip, so an empty comp matches when $cur is empty and is added to COMPREPLY.

subject: baseline
summary: The new prefix check `[[ $comp == "$cur"* ]] || continue` no longer skips empty completion lines. With an empty `$cur`, blank or description-only lines are added to COMPREPLY as empty candidates. This shows blank rows and can turn a single match into two, which skips the single-match path that strips the description.
judge_reason: Describes the empty completion line being added to COMPREPLY when $cur is empty, due to the new prefix check.
